CustomField.complianceGroup: Integrity - Accurate;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Source - Salesforce
CustomField.formula: IF(ISNULL(TestedDate__c), "", TEXT( MAX(0, /* Ensure result is non-negative */ CASE(WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), /* Check weekday of CreatedDate */ 1, CASE(MOD(DATEVALUE(TestedDate__c) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate),7),1,0,2,1,3,2,4,3,5,4,6,5,0), /* Sun */ 2, CASE(MOD(DATEVALUE(TestedDate__c) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate),7),1,1,2,2,3,3,4,4,5,4,6,4,0), /* Mon */ 3, CASE(MOD(DATEVALUE(TestedDate__c) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate),7),1,1,2,2,3,3,4,3,5,3,6,4,0), /* Tue */ 4, CASE(MOD(DATEVALUE(TestedDate__c) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate),7),1,1,2,2,3,2,4,2,5,3,6,4,0), /* Wed */ 5, CASE(MOD(DATEVALUE(TestedDate__c) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate),7),1,1,2,1,3,1,4,2,5,3,6,4,0), /* Thu */ 6, CASE(MOD(DATEVALUE(TestedDate__c) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate),7),1,0,2,0,3,1,4,2,5,3,6,4,0), /* Fri */ 7, CASE(MOD(DATEVALUE(TestedDate__c) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate),7),1,0,2,0,3,1,4,2,5,3,6,4,0), /* Sat */ -1 ) + FLOOR((DATEVALUE(TestedDate__c) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))/7)*5 ) ) + " days" )
CustomField.label: SLA - Testing
